title: Kenworth T908 T909 T950 FUPS Compliant Road Train 5 post hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #103 (rear)
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar 381 style channel with heavy duty uprights extended to lower cow catcher with 3 additional small uprights for additional protection. Standard 88mm diameter pipe but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm box uprights shown. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
